title: Why Do We Exhaust Our Inner Energy? (1973-11-19)
description:
Constantly exhausted by mental stress? Discover how to recharge your nervous system spontaneously and experience true inner silence.

This public program explores the spontaneous nature of spiritual awakening and its link to the parasympathetic nervous system. Shri Mataji explains how exhausting our energy creates ego, warns against paid gurus, and culminates in a guided self-realization meditation for thoughtless awareness.

Key Topics:
• 🌿 The true meaning of Sahaja Yoga - the spontaneous union with the Divine that requires no mental effort or physical extremes
• 🔬 Understanding your nervous system - how overusing the sympathetic channel creates ego, stress, and psychosomatic diseases
• 💭 Why purchased mantras and artificial practices cannot trigger genuine spiritual awakening or connect you to the all-pervading power
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - feel the awakening of your Kundalini and cool vibrations on your own central nervous system

“The most important thing, the only important thing, the complete importance of human beings, the existence of it, is nothing but Self-realization.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How does stress and overactivity affect spiritual growth?
• What is thoughtless awareness and how to experience it?
• How to awaken kundalini energy spontaneously and safely?

Did you feel the cool breeze or inner silence during the guided meditation? Share your first experience of self-realization below!
